purpose: Prevent mixed matter rows from flattening different agencies, statuses, and legal roles.
first_split: Orange County District Attorney’s Office / Orange County Sheriff’s Department
rules: A parent mixed row may have no single current status.
Prosecutorial agencies may be adjacent to the police corpus rather than part of the officer-misconduct entity graph.
Child agency completion or closure signals must not overwrite sibling child agency status.
Child status is still a nonclaim until source proof and display gates close.
